scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && node dist/scripts/build.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node dist/scripts/build.js --watch" "node --watch --watch-path=dist/src dist/src/server/index.js"
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts public *.json *.md playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts public *.json *.md playwright.config.ts
